messages:
Anita (Partnerships): Heads up — proposing a tweak to SI lead handoffs for the Trellis pilot. want to align ROE before we enable it :eyes:
Devon (SI): sure — what's the change?
Anita (Partnerships): shift from first-claim-wins to a 48h staging window where Sales + SI can confirm mapping. after 48h, if SI has claimed, ownership locks. goal: fewer bounced leads / duplicate outreach.
Sam (Sales): 48h sounds reasonable for normal flow. Concern: if customer requests partner intro same day we need an exception path.
Priya (Field Eng): propose an "urgent-intro" tag on intake. if set, escalate immediately to partner. need semantics for who can set it.
Devon (SI): also suggest: if SI has pre-existing relationship flag in CRM, they get immediate claim. otherwise staging applies.
Anita (Partnerships): ok draft rules: 1) si_relationship=true -> immediate assign to SI. 2) urgent-intro tag -> immediate assign to SI. 3) else -> assign to Trellis staging queue with 48h confirmation window; after that lock if claimed, else return to Sales.
Sam (Sales): tech request: SFDC needs fields: lead_claim_status, claim_timestamp, si_relationship_bool, urgent_flag, staging_deadline. ops ok to add?
Priya (Field Eng): i made a sample mapping sheet and a simple automation pseudocode for opsbot:
```
if si_relationship_bool or urgent_flag:
  owner = si_owner
else:
  owner = staging_queue
  staging_deadline = now + 48h
```
Anita (Partnerships): +1. We'll add an email ping to Sales+SI at claim start: "Confirm ownership" with accept/release buttons. one-click reduces churn.
leadbot: New lead T-2427 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). metadata: account=AcmeCo, region=NA, tags=[marketplace, hw-partner], si_relationship_bool=false
Devon (SI): for dedupe, use account_domain canonicalization first. if multiple sellers match, run manual stitch and use a no-contact hold for 24h after initial claim to avoid parallel outreach.
Sam (Sales): watch out for shared domains (subsidiaries). need manual overrides and parent-account linkback.
Anita (Partnerships): next steps: 1) Priya to post mapping sheet + SFDC field list (EOD). 2) Ops to prototype opsbot rule + "Trellis staging" queue (Fri). 3) Sales to surface 2 subsidiary edge cases. 4) Partnerships to publish short ROE + partner one-pager.
Priya (Field Eng): sheet link: https://tiny.redwood/trellis-mapping (contains SFDC sample fields & decision matrix).
Devon (SI): we'll run two test leads this week: one normal flow, one urgent-intro to validate fast-path.
Sam (Sales): can we also add a dashboard metric: avg time-to-claim and % urgent-escalations? helps tune 48h window.
Anita (Partnerships): yes — partnerships + sales ops will own metrics. add "Trellis lead metrics" to roadmap.
leadbot: automation scheduled: lead T-2427 staging_deadline = 1763335140
Devon (SI): thanks — i'll report back after test leads. if green, target pilot flip Tue 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Anita (Partnerships): i'll draft ROE + one-pager and post here for sign-off by EOD Mon.
Sam (Sales): thanks all.
Priya (Field Eng): thanks.
